description.narrative: The DNS Taskforce will focus on strengthening the expertise of GGGI’s Green Investment Services (GIS) teams, Sustainable Finance Officers, and RegionalOffice (RO) staff, ensuring they possess the necessary skills and knowledge to effectively identify, contribute-in, and eventually lead DNS projects. An important goal of the taskforce is the formalization of at least one DNS transaction in each GGGI region, which involves leveraging in country relationships by demonstrating technical rigor, to obtain formal mandate letters requesting GGGI’s DNS technical assistance. Additionally, the taskforce is set to design the world’s first multilateral DNS model. This includes developing a comprehensive white paper that will serve as a guiding document for future multilateral cooperation on debt-for-nature initiatives.Another critical aspect of the taskforce’s work is raising the profile of GGGI in global DNS initiatives through active participation in key forums, securing a role in the global UNCCC Climate Conference of Parties DNS taskforce, and mobilizing significant funding—targeting EUR 5 million—to support the prioritized in-country DNS technical assistance projects. By achieving these objectives, GGGI aims to use DNS as a powerful tool to mobilize climate and conservation finance, while assisting member countries in reducing fiscal debt stress.

The overarching goal of the Debt-for-Nature Swap (DNS) Taskforce is to position the Global Green Growth Institute (GGGI) as a global leader in the rapidly evolving and highly competitive DNS space. This initiative aims to significantly enhance GGGI's internal capabilities, build a $2 billion project pipeline for DNS, and pioneer innovative DNS approaches to tackle multilateral debt.
